title: 2030 — First city-scale program hulls pilots launch: data trusts issuan

description:
First city-scale program hulls pilots launch: data trusts issuance and program logistics exchange running live.

What must be true first: the data trusts results have to replicate outside the lab, program logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and valuation models operations need a year of continuous runtime. title: Data Dividend Programs Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Data Dividend Programs operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Data Dividend Programs installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 14966 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where data trusts monitoring, program logistics redundancy, or valuation models maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Data Dividend Programs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Data Dividend Programs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Data Dividend Programs — paying people for their data.

Phase 1 — Prove (data trusts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (valuation models): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (consent systems): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
